body.statement:
Let \(m=|\mathcal A|\), \(L=|\mathrm{LIT}|\), \(n=|V|\), \(M=|\Omega|\), \(q_M=\lceil\log_2(M+1)\rceil\), and
\[
 b_{\tau}=8(n+1)^2\left\lceil\log_2(n+L+M+2)\right\rceil.
\]
Every operationally accepted witness presentation can be normalized without increasing cost by deleting index-zero markers, representing each concrete branch by one singleton-index record, and replacing its transcript by the canonical successful transcript.  The result has exactly \(M\) records, at most \(M\) protocols, and exact length at most
\[
 B_{\mathrm{sw}}
 =2\lfloor\log_2(M+1)\rfloor+1
 +M\bigl(m+L+q_M+n(1+L)+b_{\tau}\bigr).
\]
If the operational instance is feasible, the lexicographically first minimum-cost canonical certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\) exists, dominates every operationally accepting generic acquisition, and satisfies \(N_{E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}}\leq B_{\mathrm{sw}}\).  Oracle reply lengths remain separately charged by \(N_{\mathcal O}\).
body.justification: The bound exposes every branch-ownership bit and concrete transcript while keeping oracle support payload separate.
body.gap: No published fixed-source result bounds a priced physical switching certificate.
body.consumer: The exact search has a finite radius \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), which may be exponential.
body.proof_tex:
Let an operationally accepting witness presentation be given.  If one protocol--slice--source triple is reused for several branches, copy its fixed fields once for each of those branch indices and attach the corresponding concrete transcript.  Distinct-protocol charging makes this splitting cost neutral.  Delete every index-zero marker; it supplies no successful branch, acceptance is unchanged, and cost cannot increase because all action costs are nonnegative.  Since the positive indices partition \(\{1,\ldots,M\}\), the result has exactly \(M\) nonempty records and at most \(M\) distinct protocols.

For each record, Proposition~\(\mathrm{Connected\mbox{-}ancestor\ obstruction}\) makes success equivalent to absence of an obstruction, and Lemma~\(\mathrm{Fixed\ transcript\ size}\) gives at most \(n\) strict restrictions.  We now exhibit the promised finite encoding rather than hiding its framing.  Encode the number of transcript rows first and then pad to \(n+1\) rows.  A row has a presence bit and the three \(n\)-bit masks \((U_r,H_r,B_r)\); all reachability, connectivity, and literal comparisons are recomputed from \(G\), the branch index, and the source label.  With
\[
 q=\left\lceil\log_2(n+L+M+2)\right\rceil\geq1,
\]
the row-count code, the presence bits, the masks, and the constant end markers use at most
\[
 8(n+1)^2q=b_{\tau}
 \tag{6}
\]
bits.  Thus this is a concrete realization of the bound in Lemma~\(\mathrm{Fixed\ transcript\ size}\).

The normalized list has \(r=M\).  By Definition~\(\mathrm{Sparse\ switching\ acquisition\ certificate}\), its Elias-gamma record-count prefix has exactly
\[
 2\lfloor\log_2(M+1)\rfloor+1
 \tag{7}
\]
bits.  Every record has \(m+L+q_M+n(1+L)\) fixed bits and at most \(b_{\tau}\) transcript bits.  Equations (6)--(7) give
\[
 N_{\mathrm{sw}}
 \leq2\lfloor\log_2(M+1)\rfloor+1
 +M\bigl(m+L+q_M+n(1+L)+b_{\tau}\bigr)
 =B_{\mathrm{sw}}.
 \tag{8}
\]
In particular, the ownership term is \(Mq_M\), not \(M^2\).

If a generic collection \(E_0\) makes the complete operational run return nonfailure, Theorem~\(\mathrm{Sparse\ switching\ source\ normal\ form}\) supplies a switching witness of cost at most \(\operatorname{Cost}(E_0)\); the preceding normalization preserves that domination.  The universe of protocol masks, literal masks, labelled source masks, branch indices, and canonical transcripts is finite.  Hence the set of normalized accepted strings satisfying (8) is finite.  When feasibility holds it is nonempty, so its finite set of exact binary-rational costs has a minimum; lexicographic order chooses a unique first minimizer \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{\star}\).  It obeys (8) and dominates every accepting generic acquisition.  The proof never places any oracle reply inside the certificate, so those reply bits remain charged only to \(N_{\mathcal O}\).
